name: Ultra Donutman
blurb: A silver-and-red space hero who fires spinning donut rings. Every hit glazes the enemy, slowing them, and his donuts hit harder. Ultimate: Donut Beam.

sfx.blade_hit: squishy dough impact with a sugary sparkle
sfx.ultimate: rising sci-fi energy beam charge with a bakery bell ding

art.floor: an empty evacuated city plaza at dusk: wide cracked asphalt with faded crosswalk lines and no people, no cars; tall skyscrapers with lit windows and rooftops crowding all four edges, a few damaged buildings with smoke
art.body: an original space hero: the perfectly round ball body is shiny silver metal with bold red stripe panels curving around it, a glowing cyan visor across the middle, and a pink frosted donut ring floating like a halo on top; no fin, no chest light
art.ultimate_icon: a giant glowing pink frosted donut firing a bright beam, with sprinkles bursting outward
art.ult_circle: a pink frosting magic circle with rainbow sprinkle runes
art.ult_aura: a rising pillar of pink glaze light and floating sprinkles
art.hit_fx: a pink glaze splat with rainbow sprinkles

projectiles.orb: a small spinning pink frosted donut with rainbow sprinkles

fan.idea: Love the video. It would be fun to see Ultraman shoot donut
